actions.name: create_ooxml_patch
actions.permissions: creates patch artifact; source packages unchanged

actions.name: get_live_word_selection
actions.permissions: read-only live selection inspection; issues selection token

actions.name: insert_live_word_image
actions.permissions: mutates live Word document; reads specified local image

actions.name: save_live_word_document
actions.permissions: writes the connected document to its existing path
actions.reversibility: not reversible as a file save; caller backup required

actions.name: close_live_word_document
actions.reversibility: not reversible after close; save/discard policy explicit

actions.name: quit_word_application
actions.permissions: quits Word; requires confirm=true and explicit save_changes

actions.name: disconnect_live_word_document
actions.permissions: removes local live-document handle; does not close Word document
actions.reversibility: not reversible for the handle; reconnect required
